evidence: commits.md:59-64 (939598b) says the step 1 scalar-only show was replaced and its tests moved to get, keeping the exit-2/5 cases. This matches diff.patch:3646-3659 (test_e2e_includes rename plus a check that show succeeds), diff.patch:3681-3683 (test_e2e_safety) and diff.patch:3668-3669 (test_e2e_reconcile)

commits.md:50-56 (b24d1c8) explains the step-3 notes added to the earlier specs. In diff.patch:90-103 each changed config-foundation criterion says what replaced it (get, config-get-show req 1.2 and 6.2) and why

commits.md:125-130 (a55f49b) says the scalar rules moved into the core yaml_style module because core code may not import write-back, and that set's bytes stay unchanged. This covers the removals in diff.patch:2113-2384 (scalar_render.py, block_scalar.py)

commits.md:109-114 (1114caf) explains the show_value to get_value rename and the new node_at. This covers the theatre.py hunks and the updates in tests/test_theatre.py and test_theatre_sync.py (diff.patch:5259-5521)
diff.patch:2971-2976: the comment in test_cli_set says why the registrar assertion changed (config-get-show's get registered first), matching commits.md:69-72 (1fd562d)
notes: I went through the diff hunk by hunk and every substantive one, including each modification and removal of existing specs, tests and code, is explained by a specific commit body. The changed requirements and tests say what replaced them and why. I found no hunk I would hold back for lack of a reason.
